task.title: Implement backend batch decision approval workflow
task.summary: Replace the deferred TUI-first approval task with a backend decision workflow path that can apply multiple row approve/edit/reject/defer actions in one phase call, normalize gateway approval evidence, and keep low-level diff-table mutation as internal/debug plumbing.

goal.outcome: Decision row actions can be applied in batches through a high-level wiki-named backend workflow path with gateway-compatible approval evidence.
acceptance: One backend/API entrypoint can accept, reject, defer, or edit multiple decision rows in a single phase call.
Accepted row evidence is normalized to the gateway-required approved state and decision builds no longer fail because row action strings disagree across tools.
The existing wiki_diff_table primitive remains available only as compatibility/debug/internal plumbing until the new workflow is validated.
Partial failures return exact changed refs, failed row ids, recovery guidance, and no hidden success.
Tests cover multi-row accept and mixed approve/reject/defer behavior plus gateway decision mapping compatibility.
non_goals: Do not build TUI/board approval UI in this task.
Do not merge decision and planning compilers.
Do not remove existing low-level primitives before compatibility is validated.
verification: targeted tests for decision row batching and gateway mapping

delta.desired: Backend batch decision row actions are available without requiring the deferred TUI approval surface.
delta.current: Decision row actions require repeated low-level calls and gateway approval evidence currently expects a specific normalized value.
delta.closure: Task closes when batch decision actions and gateway-compatible row approval evidence are tested and documented.
